title: Mutations and Selection
seo_title: Grade 10 Science: Mutations and Selection Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Mutations, natural selection and artificial selection change the genetic makeup of populations: types of mutations, natural selection, artificial selection, and genetic engineering and GMOs. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 10, Biology)
meta_desc: Free Grade 10 science worksheets (BC): types and effects of mutations, natural selection, antibiotic resistance, artificial selection and genetic technologies. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Selection decides which traits become common.
body_html:
How to think about it

A mutation is a change in DNA. It can be harmful, helpful or neutral. Mutations in sex cells can be passed on, and they are the source of new variation.

In natural selection, organisms with helpful traits survive and reproduce more, so those traits become common (bacteria resisting antibiotics). In artificial selection, people choose which organisms breed. Genetic engineering changes DNA directly to make genetically modified organisms (GMOs).

Example

A mutation changes one base but the protein stays the same. What kind of effect is this?

No change to the trait

Answer: neutral (silent)

Example

Farmers breed only the cows that make the most milk. What is this?

People choose.

Answer: artificial selection

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all mutations are harmful.
  • Thinking bacteria become resistant because they 'try'.
  • Mixing up artificial selection and genetic engineering.

Emma compares a DNA sequence before and after a mutation.
Before: TCCAGGAACC
After: TCCAAGAACC
What kind of mutation is it?
items.e: One base was swapped for another; the length stays the same.

items.q: Noah reads: “A mutation lets some bacteria survive an antibiotic.” This mutation is beneficial. Why?
c: No protein changes, so the trait does not change.
It does not help or hurt the cat.
It helps the bacteria survive in that environment.
items.e: Effects depend on how the protein changes and on the environment.
